meta.description: Deliberate, unhurried motion language. The split reveal is the signature — never instant, always 600ms. Like pages turning.

splitReveal.description: Left panel slides in from left (-100%), right panel from right (+100%) simultaneously

contentFade.description: Content elements resolve y:20→0 with opacity fade

titleCompress.description: Hero title letter-spacing compresses 0.1em → -0.03em on load

clipReveal.description: Sections wipe from center out via clipPath — pages closing/opening

cardStagger.description: Work cards stagger in from bottom y:40

principles: Deliberate and unhurried — motion should feel considered, not reactive
The split reveal is the signature motion — two panels arriving from opposite edges
600ms is the minimum for panel-level transitions
Stagger content within panels at 100ms intervals
Never instant — even fast transitions use the panel_slide easing
